prompt: An Angular admin feature provides a polling service at component scope and opens an overlay that resolves the same service from a different injector. Closing and reopening the feature leaves multiple pollers running and duplicated notifications appear. Diagnose the injector/lifecycle boundary, make one ownership decision, and prove teardown across feature navigation and overlay close/reopen while preserving the public service API. Do not solve by introducing a global singleton unless the required lifetime actually is application-wide.
